description.value: Wildcoast Adventures operates from Quadra Island, British Columbia, offering professionally guided sea kayaking expeditions into Johnstone Strait, Desolation Sound, and the Discovery Islands. Tours range from day paddles to seven-day glamping wilderness expeditions featuring orca and humpback whale encounters, gourmet camp meals, and access to some of BC's most remote coastline. A compelling stop for touring cyclists exploring Quadra Island who want to experience the surrounding waters.
